usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks, and Google Calendar blocks the time when “New Incomplete Task” runs “Create Calendar Event”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Incomplete Task” in Todoist, then “Create Calendar Event” in Google Calendar
bestTemplate.why: A new task gets a calendar slot with attendees and details, so it is planned, not just listed.

watchOut: “New Incomplete Task” is polling and looks only at tasks added in the last 15 minutes.
